definition_preserved: ((revenue_current-cost_current)-(revenue_comparative-cost_comparative))/mean(total_assets_current,total_assets_opening), from the same bound annual disclosure; original date-specific industry percentile and source barriers preserved
public_source_scope: Bounded read of original-author PandaAI repositories on 2026-10-12; public main is not authentication of deployed worker version or account entitlement

catalog.period_suffixes: Retained field index describes _lyr as last fiscal year and _mrq_n as the n-th previous report before query date. Neither defines n calendar days, fixed calendar quarters, TTM nor the current annual comparative role.

loader.supported_visible_entry: Literal factors['field_name'] keys in Python AST are collected, lowercased and passed to get_base_factors_pro; generic dictionary names selected only at runtime are not visibly collected by this public implementation.
loader.input_shape: get_base_factors_pro receives a merged frame and constructs a pd.Series per requested column with [date,symbol] index; it does not preserve source disclosure metadata unless those metadata are themselves explicitly requested and returned columns
loader.financial_period_announcement_version_so: Not established by the reviewed loader. A daily date index alone does not certify which annual report/current-comparative pair/version was usable on that date.
loader.public_eight_base_factor_stub: Public old FactorReader.get_factor/get_available_factors contain eight-price-field implementations/stubs; newer author tool documentation explicitly describes financial get_factor fields. The old stub is not treated as the production service support ceiling.
loader.factor_worker_network_bridge: No reviewed documented entitled bridge for the independent report API inside an official competition worker. Python import/AST permissiveness alone is not a production access contract.

independent_report_api.date_semantics: The tool converts start/end YYYYMMDD to yyyyqN quarter bounds; end_date also maps to SDK date filter. The public wrapper does not itself establish exact disclosure-publication semantics for that filter.
independent_report_api.version_semantics: is_latest defaults true in documented schema and selects latest record per symbol+quarter. A historical source contract must inspect all versions, establish publication usability and not silently take today's latest replacement backward.
independent_report_api.not_info_date: get_fina_reports has no info_date parameter in this reviewed wrapper. info_date appears in forecast/performance APIs, not this report API.
independent_report_api.annual_same_disclosure_current_comparati: Not established by wrapper schema; needs actual returned records and explicit field-role/version proof
independent_report_api.fee_evidence_scope: Bounded original-author README, API schema, skill and credential implementation review did not establish pricing/no-charge semantics; no financial request made under an assumed free entitlement.
independent_report_api.credential_contract: Original-author CredentialManager invokes panda_data.init_token(username,password). Reuse of the existing competition CLI bearer token for this SDK is not documented in reviewed sources. No credentials are placed in factor code and no new login performed.
independent_report_api.installed_cli_source_access: Sandbox file read denied for installed CLI source; no attempt to bypass and no account endpoint guessed. This is a tooling limit, not evidence financial access is unavailable.

independent_industry_api.visible_history_parameter: Reviewed get_stock_industry/get_industry_constituents schemas have code/level/fields, but no explicit historical date argument. Current membership alone cannot certify original date-specific historical industry editions.
independent_industry_api.native_factors_dynamic_industry_contract: Not found in bounded review; current source requires sector edition/as-of evidence separately

local_continuous_source: Store compact annual report-version facts keyed by symbol, report end, announcement ID, record SHA and public available_from; keep original current/comparative income and current/opening asset roles.

At a requested date, select only the latest explicitly bound annual report version whose public usable time is <= that date. Never use FY/H1/quarter aggregates to replace the registered annual same-disclosure definition.
Keep an annual report available on later dates until superseded or invalidated by an explicitly known correction/policy/scope event; do not terminate merely at the historical backtest end date.
Resolve industry edition as of requested date before within-industry ranking; unknown industry/version/scope evidence remains NaN or pending rather than zero.

Recompute percentile across current qualified universe each requested date, then original same-date common F141 cohort winsor-Z fixed-half blend; do not carry stale historical percentile rank instead of the raw annual amount fact.

official_dynamic_contract_control.fixed_small_control: Use one already bound annual disclosure with current/comparative income and current/opening assets, one known amendment/version boundary and one known annual-to-H1 transition; query supported free official report/factor inputs for dates immediately before and after public usability.
required_actual_receipt: documented fee and entitled supported query path
annual period and same-report comparative role
worker acceptance of these dynamic inputs or an officially supported external source adapter without credential literals in factor code

official_dynamic_contract_control.success_requirement: Official factor can calculate unchanged annual G for a future requested date from newly available dynamic inputs without source literal regeneration or manual code replacement. A historical local continuous ledger alone does not meet this requirement.

minimal_official_blocker: No authenticated dynamic factor-worker input contract currently binds annual same-disclosure current/comparative revenue and cost, current/opening assets, report/publication/version and date-specific industry. Names in a catalog or generic daily Series do not solve these roles. A local point-in-time continuous provider can remove historical cutoff while this official production interface remains pending.
